description:
We are a team of passionate students from Assiut STEM School, Egypt, brought together by our curiosity about space, science, and technology. As young innovators and problem-solvers, we believe that every forgotten space mission holds a story worth rediscovering.

Through research, creativity, and teamwork, we aim to transform complex space stories into an interactive experience that inspires curiosity and connects people with the remarkable achievements of space exploration.
